about: The Superstar Select's pages (Ultimate No Mercy). Each page: a name (capitals, up to 15 letters) and its Superstars, in the order the select shows them (three across, three down: nine on a page; more than nine go on over pages of their own: NAME 2, ...). Up to 32 pages. A Superstar by his string ID ("the_rock", a wrestler folder's name; stories\_roster.json has the built-in ones as "@ID:..."; also undertaker_1999, chris_benoit, caw_1 .. caw_18 for the Create-a-Wrestler boxes), by his number ("0x0105"), or both ({"id": "aki_man", "game_number": "0x0379"}: the string ID decides when the number is someone else's); or {"game": "WCW/nWo Revenge"}: every wrestler imported from that game (his wrestler.json "source": {"game": ...}), in folder order. chris_benoit is Benoit wherever he is (his own box when there's no big_show). Names ("THE ROCK") still work in older files. Anyone off the roster (the operator menu's) is left out, and so is a costume variant (UNDERTAKER 1999: he is in the UNDERTAKER's box, his Type arrows past the last costume), and a page left with nobody isn't shown. "rumble": false keeps a page out of the Royal Rumble's random draw. "unlisted": "append" puts everyone these pages leave out on pages of their own at the end (MORE, MORE 2, ...: the game's own first, then the added Superstars, then wrestler folders no page names -- other games', mods' and packs'); "hide" leaves them off the select. Mistakes are written in NoMercyRecompiled.log ([pages] ...); with no page anyone is on, the game's own pages. Delete this file for the game's own pages (the in-game page editor's).
